title: Software Engineer - UI Test
text:
ABOUT THE TEAM
The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers.

The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We do manual and automated testing, including developing the test infrastructure needed. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments. 

ABOUT THE JOB

UI Test team responsibilities:

Feature qualification:

The UI Test team qualifies new features from the end-user point of view (UI) for all Rubrik products before rolling out to production. We make sure every feature adheres to the quality standards and integrates well with the rest of the product. 

Maintains high quality bar in test processes, strategy and test execution.

Release regression testing: 

All released features are regression tested in every release, on a cadence that depends on the product, with both manual and automated UI testing.

Automation: 

New features enter the automation backlog after release and are picked up by priority. UI Automation using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright. 

Infrastructure automation/maintenance using Python.

Automated test pipelines in a CI/CD system

Each phase of the testing life cycle is getting automated. Using AI-assisted tooling to generate test cases from product artifacts, execute them against real environments to reduce manual qualification effort.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field

5-8 years of experience in software testing, UI testing and automation

Solid understanding on data protection, storage, security, virtualization, databases, cloud, kubernetes and generative AI

Familiarity with UI performance and accessibility testing.

Working knowledge of microservices, API, cloud native architectures and how to test them

Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, AI resilience. A cloud certification is an advantage.

Deep experience in driving complete test life cycle (test planning, execution, automation) and release qualification. Test management using TestRail or equivalent is a plus.

Good hands-on experience programming in Python or equivalent and UI automation using TestIM, Selenium, Playwright or equivalent. JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge is a plus.

Hands-on experience using AI coding or testing assistants in test authoring, debugging or automation, and sound judgment about the quality of their output.

Hands on experience in creating, triaging and maintaining automated test pipeline using Jenkins, GitHub or similar CI/CD tools

Strong written and verbal communication, including documentation that others can pick up without a handoff.

Key differentiating factors:

Due to the unique placement of the team, it is exposed to multiple key technologies of Rubrik products. 

This opportunity is not just another manual testing or automation role, key factor is the exposure and opportunity to learn core technologies of data protection, storage, security, anti ransomware, Virtualization(Hyper-V, VMware), Databases (SQL, Oracle, Mongo, DB2), cloud technologies (Azure, Google, AWS), Kubernetes, and cutting edge features involving Generative AI etc.

Exposure to automated infrastructure creation and clean up on various platforms like VMware, Azure, AWS etc.

Hands-on work with AI-based tools for test authoring, execution and automation.

Automation using latest AI based tools

title: Engineer II - Cloud
text:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: 
This is a Cloud/Backend development position in the Falcon Exposure Management team. The Exposure Management team focuses on continuous assessment of security configurations and vulnerability landscapes across cloud and hybrid environments in near real time. This involves understanding security misconfigurations, compliance frameworks, vulnerability data sources, and how adversaries may exploit these weaknesses to compromise enterprise environments. This person will be required to build solutions for configuration and vulnerability data sources, gather and normalize assessment data, analyze security posture gaps, assess risk criticality, and automate remediation workflows. They will also be responsible for troubleshooting issues with current assessment data and making platform enhancements. 

What You'll Do:
Engineering efforts from rapid prototypes to developing large-scale application services for configuration assessment and vulnerability management content
Work with security researchers and vulnerability analysts to troubleshoot time-sensitive production issues related to configuration drift and vulnerability detection
Extensive use of Golang or Java, AWS/GCP cloud services, and relational and distributed databases
Ensure security, accuracy, and efficacy of configuration assessment data and vulnerability intelligence
Backend engineering systems and process automation for configuration compliance and vulnerability management workflows
Build vulnerability and configuration tracking capabilities by conducting analysis on asset configurations, vulnerability data, and compliance benchmarks to provide reviewed content to the platform team for product efficacy
Interact and integrate with platform teams and product teams
Constantly re-engineering to improve architecture, risk scoring models, user experience, performance and stability
 
What You'll Need:
Solid work experience in Golang or Java development
Strong database skills with relational databases and distributed databases like Cassandra, Redis & ElasticSearch
Exposure to AWS/GCP cloud services and cloud security assessment tools 
Experience delivering high quality & tested code
Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, vulnerability management, and security configuration assessment
Knowledge of security configuration frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, SOC 2, etc.)
Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization
Team collaboration skills and ability to work in a global, distributed team
The skills to meet commitments on time and produce high quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration
